```artifact
Feature: Self-Test Suite for U15_Self_Test

  Scenario: Validate flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to a speed of "as specified"
    And air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the flow sensor accuracy should be validated
    And the expected flow rate should be within the acceptable range

  Scenario: Validate pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is in operation
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the pressure sensor accuracy should be validated
    And the expected pressure should be within the acceptable range

  Scenario: Support pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in normal mode
    When the pre-test mode is initiated
    Then the controller should enter pre-test mode
    And the GUI should display the pre-test mode

  Scenario: GUI support for pre-test mode
    Given the GUI is open
    And the controller is in normal mode
    When the pre-test mode is initiated
    Then the GUI should display the pre-test mode
    And the controller should enter pre-test mode

  Scenario Outline: Controller pre-test mode checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the following checks should be performed:
      | Check Type       | Expected Result |
      |------------------|-----------------|
      | Flow Sensor      | Accuracy validated |
      | Pressure Sensor  | Accuracy validated |
      | Air Lines        | Open            |
      | Output Connection| None            |
      | Controller Mode  | Pre-test mode   |
      | GUI State        | Pre-test mode   |

    Examples:
      | Check Type       | Expected Result |
      |------------------|-----------------|
      | Flow Sensor      | Accuracy validated |
      | Pressure Sensor  | Accuracy validated |
      | Air Lines        | Open            |
      | Output Connection| None            |
      | Controller Mode  | Pre-test mode   |
      | GUI State        | Pre-test mode   |
```
